title: "renv::install(repos = ) could install a version missing from the repository"
ref: RNV-02
categories: [renv and installation]
impact: silencieux
attendu: "`xfun` 0.48, the version available on this dated repository"
versions: "Old versions of {renv}, fixed in recent versions"
source: "Slack ThinkR (2026)"
---

::: {.piege .piege-statique}
```r
renv::install("xfun", repos = "https://p3m.dev/cran/2024-10-30")
```

```text
The following package(s) will be installed:
- xfun [0.57]
```
:::

This pitfall depends on an old version of {renv} and the network, so it cannot be replayed in the browser.

## Why

In the original incident, a project used an old version of {renv}. With `repos =` pointing to a snapshot dated 30 October 2024, `renv::install()` offered `xfun` 0.57, a much more recent version than the one in that repository. The repository passed as an argument therefore did not restrict the version lookup.

`utils::install.packages()` with the same `repos =` did download `xfun` 0.48. After updating {renv}, `renv::install()` offers 0.48 too.

## The fix

Update {renv}, then read the list of proposed versions before accepting the installation.

::: {.piege .piege-statique}
```r
renv::upgrade()
renv::install("xfun", repos = "https://p3m.dev/cran/2024-10-30")
```

```text
The following package(s) will be installed:
- xfun [0.48]
```
:::
